topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Biology and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, sets expectations for the cohort, and outlines the session's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops as a failure of normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture, and address the experimental models used to study this multicellular organisation.

topics.label: Distinguishing and classifying benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish how benign and malignant tumors are distinguished through their invasive properties, histological progression, and pathological nomenclature.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical, physiological, and systemic mechanisms by which primary tumors and metastatic lesions cause disease and death.

topics.label: Comparative incidence of cancer across tissues and species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the comparative incidence and patterns of tumor development across different human tissue lineages and multicellular animal species.

topics.label: Principles and practice of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical rationale, diagnostic methods, and practical challenges of screening for cancer across different anatomical sites.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and upcoming practicals
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes and announcing arrangements for subsequent practicals and sessions.
